jp:
「桃太郎さん！
　気をつけて　ください！」
　{KP}
「下の階にいる　{bb}夜叉・キシボ{ww}は
　こうふんして　いますから！」
　{KP}
「あの　こうふんを　しずめるには
　{bb}ろっかく仙人{ww}が　持っている
　{bb}ろっかくの玉{ww}くらいの　いりょくを」{KP}
　
「{bb}キシボ{ww}に　当てないと
　ダメでしょうね！」
　{KP}
「もともと　{bb}キシボ{ww}は　やさしい
　夜叉だったんですけど
　どうしたのでしょうか？」
en: "Momotaro-san! Please be careful!"{KP}"{bb}Yasha Kishibo{ww}, on the floor below, is all worked up!"{KP}"To calm her down, you'd need something as powerful as the {bb}Hexagon Orb{ww} that the {bb}Hexagon Hermit{ww} has,"{KP}"and you'd have to hit {bb}Kishibo{ww} with it!"{KP}"{bb}Kishibo{ww} used to be a gentle yasha, though. I wonder what happened to her?"

jp:
「やりましたね　桃太郎さん！
　夜叉・キシボも　{bb}鬼子母神{ww}と
　改名して」{KP}
　
「子守所を　開いて
　子どもたちの　面倒を
　見ているようですよ！」
en: "You did it, Momotaro-san! Yasha Kishibo has changed her name to {bb}Kishibojin{ww},"{KP}"opened a nursery, and is looking after the children, it seems!"

"Ah, it's Momotaro, chi!"{KP}"W-wait a sec, chi! I'm not fighting anymore, chi!"{KP}"I ran away from the Oni Mask Gang, chi!"{KP}"Rokuemon-sama got too scary, chi!"{KP}"Rokuemon-sama really is trying to revive the God of Destruction, chi!"{KP}"Huh? 'Tell me all about it, chi,' you say? Well..."{KP}"On the way here, Rokuemon-sama tore up and threw away"{KP}"the {bb}Revival Book of the God of Destruction{ww}. If I had that, I could explain, chi!"

jp:
「えっ？　はかい神の　ことを
　くわしく　教えて　くれろっちと
　言われても…」{KP}
「ここに　来る　途中
　六右衛門さまが　やぶりすてた
　{KP}
「{bb}はかい神の復活書{ww}でも
　あれば　説明できるっち！」
en: "Huh? 'Tell me all about the God of Destruction, chi,' you say? Well..."{KP}"On the way here, Rokuemon-sama tore up and threw away"{KP}"the {bb}Revival Book of the God of Destruction{ww}. If I had that, I could explain, chi!"

jp:
桃太郎は
{bb}{MM}{ww}を　見せた！

en: "Huh? You brought the {bb}Revival Book of the God of Destruction{ww}, chi..."{KP}"Okay, listen close, chi! I can't read all of it either, chi, but......"{KP}"'To summon the God of Destruction, ring every Bell of Destruction that sleeps across the land at Haruma Field in Hell...'"{KP}"'But offer to the God of Destruction a soul that is not human and that hates humans!'"{KP}"That's what it says, chi."{KP}"Looks like they picked a Poverty God as the soul that hates humans, chi!"{KP}"Rokuemon-sama's gonna revive the God of Destruction no matter what it takes, chi!"

jp:
「おおー　また　こわくなったっち！
　もう　ふる里に　帰るっち！」
en: "Ohh, I'm getting scared again, chi! I'm going back to my hometown, chi!"
